outline_reconstruction.how: Manually matched all four painted corners of each of the two complete Small pads between the Raven image resampled to 2048x826 and source image. Normalized DLT homography projects full Raven Large pad corners into source-image coordinates. Match residual mean 4.31 px, max 9.23 px on the eight selected source anchors. The extrapolated full rectangle was regularized to square corners and anchored to directly visible northern paint edge. Hidden depth is finally inferred from the agreed pad dimension under the independently fitted image transform. It is not a scale control. The earlier Raven/aspect-based proposal is retained separately as uncertain diagnostic evidence.
inferred_geometry: Full reconstructed Large pad; the northern painted long edge is visible, while the southern edge lies beyond the original image and bottom legend. Do not clip the full JSON outline to y=875. Full outline is square-corner regularization of Raven terrain-plane registration; hidden extent remains approximate.

Hidden depth is finally inferred from the agreed pad dimension under the independently fitted image transform. It is not a scale control. The earlier Raven/aspect-based proposal is retained separately as uncertain diagnostic evidence.

pad-south-visible.notes: Full corrected outline is stored, including documented inferred hidden geometry. Source crop remains; original visible fragment is preserved in the pad record.

uncertain: All heights and floor counts are low-confidence visual estimates from the Side image; no scale or measured elevations are supplied. Point floor is null throughout because icon numbers and L0/>L0 describe security/access, not physical storeys.
All outlines are approximate original-frame pixel traces. Orthogonal stepped domes approximate curved roofs; eaves, occlusion and editorial markers prevent recovery of exact ground walls.

The six round modules and their connecting/service annex roofs are segmented into individual footprints. Unlabelled annex association is tentative; physical icon attachment to the adjoining footprint is marked low where the icon centre is displaced or borders two structures.

Historical tracing note, superseded by this revision's scale and verified pad classes: Pad outlines have no size classification. Northern/eastern rectangles are visual traces from painted boundaries only. No pad count appears in fingerprint.

Southern pad is clipped by the bottom legend at y=875. Its polygon and centre describe ONLY the visible strip, not a completed pad or the actual pad centre. The unseen southern boundary is intentionally not reconstructed.
Thirty-four low green agricultural modules are individually traced as details: two arrays each with row counts 6,5,6. These are not added to HAB count or inferred as living accommodation.

Small utility objects are outlined only where separable from ground and shadows; container/mast identification remains low confidence. detail_notes and detail_confidence contain these qualifications separately, keeping each details entry to id/kind/outline.
Carets in red 2^ and the cyan terminal pictogram are transcribed literally; their exact meaning or physical storey is not inferred.
Paths stop where a roof connection or paving is visible. Gaps between path segments and door icons are intentional; no continuous route or bridge is invented through unpaved/occluded gaps.

Blue i markers are editorial tips with unavailable popup content. Orange upper-left website information control, menu, legend, ships, holographic pad numbers, terrain rocks, people, shadows and touchdown-circle artwork are excluded from settlement geometry and points.
Current pad correction pad-south-visible: low confidence. Hidden or snow-obscured edges are inferred; the correction evidence and original visible polygon are retained.

validation_notes: Original local pixel geometry remains unchanged.

outline_reconstruction.how: Manually matched all four painted corners of each of the two complete Small pads between the Raven image resampled to 2048x826 and source image. Normalized DLT homography projects full Raven Large pad corners into source-image coordinates. Match residual mean 4.31 px, max 9.23 px on the eight selected source anchors. The extrapolated full rectangle was regularized to square corners and anchored to directly visible northern paint edge. Hidden depth is finally inferred from the agreed pad dimension under the independently fitted image transform. It is not a scale control. The earlier Raven/aspect-based proposal is retained separately as uncertain diagnostic evidence.
inferred_geometry: Full reconstructed Large pad; the northern painted long edge is visible, while the southern edge lies beyond the original image and bottom legend. Do not clip the full JSON outline to y=875. Full outline is square-corner regularization of Raven terrain-plane registration; hidden extent remains approximate.

Hidden depth is finally inferred from the agreed pad dimension under the independently fitted image transform. It is not a scale control. The earlier Raven/aspect-based proposal is retained separately as uncertain diagnostic evidence.

geometry_m.superseded_note: Kept for traceability. site_m holds the plan fitted to SrvSurvey's measured positions, in SrvSurvey's site frame.

frame.origin: Settlement position from the journal (ApproachSettlement Latitude/Longitude), as SrvSurvey uses it
frame.heading: Site heading = ship heading while docked on pad 1, or ship heading minus that pad's rotation_deg on any other pad (SrvSurvey HumanSiteData).
frame.to_world: bearing = heading + atan2(x, y); east = x*cos(h) + y*sin(h); north = -x*sin(h) + y*cos(h)
frame.rotation_convention: rotation_deg and rot_deg are clockwise from +y
frame.floor_convention: SrvSurvey floors: 1 = ground floor, 2 = one floor up, 3 = two floors up. SrvSurvey also uses 0: on every combat-zone point and on a few others, where its meaning isn't documented; those are copied as given. floor_basis says where each floor came from: srvsurvey, or icon carets (the plan's ^ marks, no caret = ground floor). plan_floor keeps the plan's reading where SrvSurvey's differs.
frame.access_convention: Security level 0-3: SrvSurvey's level where matched, otherwise the plan's printed number
frame.source_convention: plan = only on the plan; srvsurvey = only in SrvSurvey; plan+srvsurvey = both, at SrvSurvey's position

site_m.pixel_to_site_note: [X, Y, W] = M . [px, py, 1]; site = (X/W, Y/W). Third row is [0, 0, 1] for a uniform fit.

flags: source image needed a perspective correction (local scale 0.255-0.595 m/px)
